children: The two-year Treasury yield reached a new 27-month high on Wednesday, as investors braced for a period of interest rate increases by the U.S. Federal Reserve.
The benchmark yield, which tends to react to the Fed's moves more than longer-term Treasurys, rose to 4.798%, the highest since June 2024, when it settled at 4.832%, according to Tradeweb.
The Fed raised rates last week for the first time since 2023 and officials have indicated more hikes could be upcoming.
The 10-year yield also rose, but remained below recent highs, at 4.992%.
